reuse.why: Consolidates four action queries into getBulkEditableCategories, but copyPreviousMonth does not use it and keeps its own hidden check plus a separate hasSavedTemplates predicate.

duplication.why: The exclusion rule (hidden, hidden group, saved templates as not NULL/''/'[]') is written twice: once as SQL in getBulkEditableCategories and once as a TypeScript condition in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: Both definitions sit in budget/actions.ts next to the actions, which matches the tree's layering.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and the budget data query are touched.

maintainability.why: Changing what counts as a saved template or an excluded category requires keeping an SQL clause and a TS predicate in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth filters budgetData with its own hidden/group_hidden/hasSavedTemplates check instead of using getBulkEditableCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The template rule appears as the SQL clause (goal_def IS NULL OR goal_def IN ('', '[]')) and as hasSavedTemplates in TypeScript: the same rule in a different form.

one_place.where: getBulkEditableCategories (SQL) serves setZero and the 3/6/12-month averages; copyPreviousMonth applies the rule separately with hasSavedTemplates and its own hidden check.
